Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e676574456c656d5f72616e6765}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e676574456c656d5f72616e6765}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f72616e6765}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f72616e6765}}, propositional extensionality, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f706f735f696666}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f706f735f696666}}, \paperlink{premise:4966662e6d7072}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4966662e6d7072}}, \paperlink{theorem:6}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:6}}, \(p \ne 0\) and substitution of equals in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(0 + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(0 + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = \mathrm{true} \land (\forall j\, :\, \mathbb{N},\; \forall \mathit{hji}\, :\, j < 0,\; \operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = \mathrm{false})\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:53756273696e676c65746f6e2e656c696d}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:53756273696e676c65746f6e2e656c696d}}, \paperlink{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}}, \paperlink{premise:7a65726f5f616464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:7a65726f5f616464}}, substitution of equals, \paperlink{premise:6465636964655f65715f747275655f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6465636964655f65715f747275655f6571}}, \paperlink{premise:666f72616c6c5f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:666f72616c6c5f636f6e6772}}, \paperlink{premise:696d706c6965735f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:696d706c6965735f74727565}}, \paperlink{premise:616e645f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:616e645f74727565}} and the identity established above in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{theorem:9}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:9}} (using \(p \ne 0\)) in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{tail}(\operatorname{drop\,Last}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{tail}(\operatorname{drop\,Last}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e636f756e745f65715f6f6e655f6f665f6d656d}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e636f756e745f65715f6f6e655f6f665f6d656d}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6e6f6475705f636f6e73}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6e6f6475705f636f6e73}}, \paperlink{premise:65715f66616c7365}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f66616c7365}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6e6f745f6d656d5f6e696c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6e6f745f6d656d5f6e696c}}, \paperlink{premise:6e6f745f66616c73655f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6e6f745f66616c73655f65715f74727565}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6e6f6475705f6e696c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6e6f6475705f6e696c}}, \paperlink{premise:616e645f73656c66}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:616e645f73656c66}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6d656d5f636f6e73}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6d656d5f636f6e73}}, \paperlink{premise:6f725f66616c7365}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f725f66616c7365}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e636f756e745f636f6e735f6f665f6e65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e636f756e745f636f6e735f6f665f6e65}}, \paperlink{premise:696e73744c617766756c424571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:696e73744c617766756c424571}}, \paperlink{premise:65715f66616c736527}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f66616c736527}}, \paperlink{premise:6f6e655f6e655f7a65726f}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f6e655f6e655f7a65726f}}, \paperlink{premise:4e61742e696e73744e655a65726f53756363}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e696e73744e655a65726f53756363}} and the auxiliary result established above in the preceding result gives \(\mathrm{False}\).
The contradiction rules out this case. Hence \(\mathrm{False}\).
\end{proofstep}
The contrary assumption leads to a contradiction. Hence \(0 < \operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right)\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:21}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Assume \(p \ne 0\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)).\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
By \paperlink{theorem:6}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:6}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right) \ne \langle\,\rangle \iff p \ne 0\).
Use the hypothesis \(p \ne 0\).
By the reverse implication, we obtain \(\operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right) \ne \langle\,\rangle\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f706f735f6f665f6e655f6e696c}{\emph{Alias}} (\paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f706f735f6f665f6e655f6e696c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f706f735f6f665f6e655f6e696c}}) with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Step}\), we obtain \(0 < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right))\).
The substitution uses the following argument.
\begin{proofstep}
Fix \(x\) in \(\mathbb{N}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6d656d5f72616e6765}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6d656d5f72616e6765}}, we obtain \(x \in \operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \iff x < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\).
By propositional extensionality, we obtain \((x \in \operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = (x < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
Applying the same function to equal arguments, we obtain \((y \mapsto x \in \operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \land y) = (y \mapsto x < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \land y)\).
By \paperlink{premise:6465636964655f65715f747275655f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6465636964655f65715f747275655f6571}}, we obtain \((\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = \mathrm{true}) = (\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))))\).
By congruence, we obtain \((x \in \operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \land \operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = \mathrm{true}) = (x < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \land \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))))\).
\end{proofstep}
Choose the witness \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right)) - 1\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\neg (\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}}, we obtain \(1 \le \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \land \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 = \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 \lor \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) < 1 \land \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 = 0\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(1 \le \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \land \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 = \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 - (\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 - (\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
Reversing the equality, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) = \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 - (\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1)\).
Use the hypothesis \(1 \le \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \land \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 = \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\).
Taking the second conjunct, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 = \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 - (\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1) = 0\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) = 0\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464457175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464457175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) = \mathrm{true}\).
Use the hypothesis \(\neg (\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4e61742e6c655f6f665f6e6f745f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e6c655f6f665f6e6f745f6c74}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \le \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\).

By definition, we obtain \(0 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - (0 + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - (0 + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-(-1)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{combine}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{none},\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none})),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1\rangle)) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}}, we obtain \(\mathrm{False}\).
\end{proofstep}
The two alternatives exhaust the cases. Hence \(\mathrm{False}\).
\end{proofstep}
The contrary assumption leads to a contradiction. Hence \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:4479636b576f72642e636f756e745f555f65715f636f756e745f44}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4479636b576f72642e636f756e745f555f65715f636f756e745f44}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e74616b655f6f665f6c656e6774685f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e74616b655f6f665f6c656e6774685f6c65}}, \paperlink{premise:6c655f7265666c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f7265666c}} and \paperlink{premise:4e61742e7375625f6164645f63616e63656c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e7375625f6164645f63616e63656c}} (using \(0 < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right))\)) gives \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
Combining the two conclusions, we obtain \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \land \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - 1 + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
This witness proves existence. Hence \(\exists x\, :\, \mathbb{N},\; x < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \land \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:66756e657874}{\emph{Function extensionality}} (\paperlink{premise:66756e657874}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:66756e657874}}) and the identity established above in the preceding result gives \(\exists x\, :\, \mathbb{N},\; x \in \operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \land \operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(x + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e66696e644964785f6c745f6c656e6774685f6f665f657869737473}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e66696e644964785f6c745f6c656e6774685f6f665f657869737473}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{N}\), we obtain \(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p) < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f72616e6765}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f72616e6765}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right) < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right))\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:22}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Assume \(p \ne 0\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))).\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
By \paperlink{theorem:21}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:21}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right) < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f72616e6765}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f72616e6765}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) = \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))))\).
Substituting equals, we obtain \(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p) < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e66696e644964785f676574456c656d}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e66696e644964785f676574456c656d}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{N}\), we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{find\,Idx}(i \mapsto \operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))))) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{find\,Idx}(i \mapsto \operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))))) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Use the previously proved fact \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{find\,Idx}(i \mapsto \operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))))) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{find\,Idx}(i \mapsto \operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))))) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:53756273696e676c65746f6e2e656c696d}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:53756273696e676c65746f6e2e656c696d}}, \paperlink{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e676574456c656d5f72616e6765}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e676574456c656d5f72616e6765}}, \paperlink{theorem:21}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:21}}, \(p \ne 0\), \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f72616e6765}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f72616e6765}}, substitution of equals and \paperlink{premise:6465636964655f65715f747275655f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6465636964655f65715f747275655f6571}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:23}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Let \(i\) be a natural number. Assume \(i < \operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right)\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) < \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))).\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
Use the hypothesis \(i < \operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6e6f745f6f665f6c745f66696e64496478}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6e6f745f6f665f6c745f66696e64496478}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{N}\), we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} i) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} i) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = \mathrm{false}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4479636b576f72642e636f756e745f445f6c655f636f756e745f55}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4479636b576f72642e636f756e745f445f6c655f636f756e745f55}} with \(\mathit{self} = p\) and \(i + 1\) in place of its parameter \(i\), we obtain \(\operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \le \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
Use the previously proved fact \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} i) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} i) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))) = \mathrm{false}\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:6465636964655f65715f66616c73655f6966665f6e6f74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6465636964655f65715f66616c73655f6966665f6e6f74}} in the preceding result gives \(\neg (\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} i) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} i) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:6e655f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6e655f6571}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} i) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \ne \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))),\allowbreak{} i) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e676574456c656d5f72616e6765}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e676574456c656d5f72616e6765}}, \paperlink{premise:4e61742e6c655f7472616e73}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e6c655f7472616e73}} (using \(i < \operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right)\)) and \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e66696e644964785f6c655f6c656e677468}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e66696e644964785f6c655f6c656e677468}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \ne \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4e652e73796d6d}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e652e73796d6d}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{N}\), we obtain \(\operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) \ne \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c745f6f665f6c655f6f665f6e65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c745f6f665f6c655f6f665f6e65}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{N}\), we obtain \(\operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) < \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:24}
Let \(p\) and \(q\) be elements of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p + q) = \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases}.\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
Distinguish whether \(p = 0\) holds.
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(p = 0\).
Rewriting with \(p = 0\) and \paperlink{premise:7a65726f5f616464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:7a65726f5f616464}} gives \(\operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p + q\right) = \operatorname{first\,Return}\left(q\right)\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:69665f706f73}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:69665f706f73}} (using \(p = 0\)) in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p + q) = \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases}\).
\end{proofstep}
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\neg \left(p = 0\right)\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q) = \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(q)\).
The substitution uses the following argument.
\begin{proofstep}
Fix \(j\) in \(\mathbb{N}\).
For the required implication, argue as follows.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(j < \operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right)\).
For the required implication, argue as follows.
\begin{proofstep}
Fix \(h_{1}\) in \(\operatorname{Decidable}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))))\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q)))) = \operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))))\).
By \paperlink{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}} with \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q)))\) in place of its parameter \(p\), we obtain \(\operatorname{Decidable}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))))\text{ has at most one element}\).

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:25}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{first\,Return}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(p)) = \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) + 1.\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}

\par\smallskip\noindent\paperlineanchor{aux:25:1}\textbf{Auxiliary lemma~25.1.} Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Let \(j\) be a natural number. Then \(\mathrm{False}\).

\begin{proofstep}

By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle -1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle j\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\rangle)))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{combine}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none})),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle -1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle j\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)))\rangle)))) = \mathrm{true}\).

Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:53756273696e676c65746f6e2e656c696d}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:53756273696e676c65746f6e2e656c696d}}, \paperlink{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}}, \paperlink{premise:6164645f7a65726f}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6164645f7a65726f}}, substitution of equals and \paperlink{premise:6465636964655f65715f66616c73655f6966665f6e6f74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6465636964655f65715f66616c73655f6966665f6e6f74}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) + 1 = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) + 0) = \mathrm{false}\).

Rewriting with the two identities established above and the auxiliary result established above in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j - \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)),\allowbreak{} \langle D\rangle)) + 1 = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)) \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j - \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)),\allowbreak{} \langle D\rangle)) + 0) = \mathrm{false}\).

Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:53756273696e676c65746f6e2e656c696d}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:53756273696e676c65746f6e2e656c696d}}, \paperlink{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e446563696461626c65}}, \paperlink{premise:6974655f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6974655f636f6e6772}}, \paperlink{premise:6265715f73656c665f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6265715f73656c665f65715f74727565}}, \paperlink{premise:696e73744c617766756c424571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:696e73744c617766756c424571}}, \paperlink{premise:65715f73656c66}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f73656c66}} and substitution of equals in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)) + \begin{cases}1 &\text{if } \operatorname{BEq\mathord{:}beq}(U,\allowbreak{} U) = \mathrm{true}\\ 0 &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)) + \begin{cases}1 &\text{if } \operatorname{BEq\mathord{:}beq}(U,\allowbreak{} D) = \mathrm{true}\\ 0 &\text{otherwise}\end{cases}) = \mathrm{false}\).

By the preceding argument, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j + 1,\allowbreak{} \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(j + 1,\allowbreak{} \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle))) = \mathrm{false}\).

Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:6465636964655f65715f747275655f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6465636964655f65715f747275655f6571}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) + 1) + 1,\allowbreak{} \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) + 1) + 1,\allowbreak{} \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle))) = \mathrm{true} \land (\forall j\, :\, \mathbb{N},\; \forall \mathit{hji}\, :\, j < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) + 1,\; \operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{get\,Elem}(\operatorname{range}(\operatorname{length}(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle)),\allowbreak{} j) + 1,\allowbreak{} \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle))) = \mathrm{false})\).

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:26}
\(\operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(0\right) = 0\).
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
By \paperlink{premise:65715f73656c66}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f73656c66}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\) and \(a = 0\), we obtain \(\left(0 = 0\right) = \mathrm{True}\).
By \paperlink{premise:646974655f636f6e645f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:646974655f636f6e645f65715f74727565}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\), we obtain \(\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } 0 = 0\\ \operatorname{denest}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}take}(0,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(0) + 1)) &\text{given } h\text{ proving } \neg (0 = 0)\end{cases} = 0\).
Applying the same function to equal arguments, we obtain \((\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } 0 = 0\\ \operatorname{denest}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}take}(0,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(0) + 1)) &\text{given } h\text{ proving } \neg (0 = 0)\end{cases} = 0) = (0 = 0)\).
By \paperlink{premise:65715f73656c66}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f73656c66}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\) and \(a = 0\), we obtain \(\left(0 = 0\right) = \mathrm{True}\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \((\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } 0 = 0\\ \operatorname{denest}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}take}(0,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(0) + 1)) &\text{given } h\text{ proving } \neg (0 = 0)\end{cases} = 0) = \mathrm{True}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6f665f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f665f65715f74727565}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(0\right) = 0\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:27}
\(\operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(0\right) = 0\).
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
By \paperlink{premise:65715f73656c66}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f73656c66}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\) and \(a = 0\), we obtain \(\left(0 = 0\right) = \mathrm{True}\).
By \paperlink{premise:646974655f636f6e645f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:646974655f636f6e645f65715f74727565}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\), we obtain \(\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } 0 = 0\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(0,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(0) + 1) &\text{given } h\text{ proving } \neg (0 = 0)\end{cases} = 0\).
Applying the same function to equal arguments, we obtain \((\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } 0 = 0\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(0,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(0) + 1) &\text{given } h\text{ proving } \neg (0 = 0)\end{cases} = 0) = (0 = 0)\).
By \paperlink{premise:65715f73656c66}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f73656c66}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\) and \(a = 0\), we obtain \(\left(0 = 0\right) = \mathrm{True}\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \((\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } 0 = 0\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(0,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(0) + 1) &\text{given } h\text{ proving } \neg (0 = 0)\end{cases} = 0) = \mathrm{True}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6f665f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f665f65715f74727565}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(0\right) = 0\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:28}
Let \(p\) and \(q\) be elements of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Assume \(p \ne 0\). Then \(\operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(p + q\right) = \operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(p\right)\).
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
We first prove the following auxiliary lemmas.
\par\smallskip\noindent\paperlineanchor{aux:28:1}\textbf{Auxiliary lemma~28.1.} Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Let \(i\) be a natural number. Assume \(0 < i\). Assume \(\neg \left(i = i - 1 + 1\right)\). Then \(\mathrm{False}\).
\par\noindent\emph{Proof of the auxiliary lemma.} Use the hypothesis \(\neg \left(i = i - 1 + 1\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:4e61742e6c745f6f725f67745f6f665f6e65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e6c745f6f725f67745f6f665f6e65}}, we obtain \(i < i - 1 + 1 \lor i > i - 1 + 1\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(i < i - 1 + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}}, we obtain \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1 \lor i < 1 \land i - 1 = 0\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}} in reverse gives \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - 1 - (i - 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 - (i - 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Reversing the equality, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = i - 1 - (i - 1)\).
Use the hypothesis \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1\).
Taking the second conjunct, we obtain \(i - 1 = i - 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}}, we obtain \(i - 1 - \left(i - 1\right) = 0\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = 0\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464457175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464457175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Use the hypothesis \(i < i - 1 + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(i < i - 1 + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6164645f6f6e655f6c655f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6164645f6f6e655f6c655f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(i + 1 \le i - 1 + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}}, we obtain \(0 \le i - 1 + 1 - \left(i + 1\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}} with \(n = i - 1\) and \(m = 1\), we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 = i - 1 + 1\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}} in reverse gives \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).

Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).

By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).

\begin{proofstep}
