By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1) = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1)\).
\end{proofstep}
The substitution uses the following argument.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\mathrm{False} \land q = 0\).
By definition, we obtain \(0 = 0\).
\end{proofstep}
The substitution uses the following argument.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\neg \left(\mathrm{False} \land q = 0\right)\).
For the required implication, argue as follows.
\begin{proofstep}
Fix \(i\) in \(\mathbb{N}\).
Fix \(i_{1}\) in \(\mathbb{N}\).
Assume \(i = i_{1}\).
For the required implication, argue as follows.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} i) = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} i)\).
\end{proofstep}
Use the hypothesis \(i = i_{1}\).
Substituting equals, we obtain \(\forall \mathit{hi}\, :\, \operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(i,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))),\; \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} i) = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} i_{1})\).
\end{proofstep}
By definition, we obtain \(p + q = p + q\).
Use the hypothesis \(p \ne 0\).
By \paperlink{premise:65715f66616c7365}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f66616c7365}}, we obtain \(\left(p = 0\right) = \mathrm{False}\).
For the required implication, argue as follows.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\mathrm{False}\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{first\,Return}\left(q\right) = \operatorname{first\,Return}\left(q\right)\).
\end{proofstep}
For the required implication, argue as follows.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\neg \mathrm{False}\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right) = \operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right)\).
\end{proofstep}
By \paperlink{premise:6974655f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6974655f636f6e6772}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{N}\), we obtain \(\begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} = \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases}\).
Applying the same function to equal arguments, we obtain \(\begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1 = \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1\).
By definition, we obtain \(\left(p + q = 0\right) = \left(p + q = 0\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:556e697175652e696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:556e697175652e696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Add\,Units}\left(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\right)\), we obtain \(\operatorname{Add\,Units}\left(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\right)\text{ has at most one element}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6164645f65715f7a65726f27}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6164645f65715f7a65726f27}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\), we obtain \(p + q = 0 \iff p = 0 \land q = 0\).
By propositional extensionality, we obtain \(\left(p + q = 0\right) = \left(p = 0 \land q = 0\right)\).
Use the hypothesis \(p \ne 0\).
By \paperlink{premise:65715f66616c7365}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f66616c7365}}, we obtain \(\left(p = 0\right) = \mathrm{False}\).
Applying the same function to equal arguments, we obtain \(\left(p = 0 \land q = 0\right) = \left(\mathrm{False} \land q = 0\right)\).
Use the hypothesis \(\neg \left(\mathrm{False} \land q = 0\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:45712e6d70725f6e6f74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:45712e6d70725f6e6f74}}, we obtain \(\neg \left(p = 0 \land q = 0\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:45712e6d70725f6e6f74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:45712e6d70725f6e6f74}}, we obtain \(\neg \left(p + q = 0\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:45712e6d70725f6e6f74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:45712e6d70725f6e6f74}}, we obtain \(\neg \left(p + q = 0\right)\).
By \paperlink{theorem:22}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:22}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p + q) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p + q) + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q)))\).
By \paperlink{theorem:24}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:24}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p + q) = \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases}\).
Applying the same function to equal arguments, we obtain \(\operatorname{first\,Return}(p + q) + 1 = \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1\).
Substituting equals, we obtain \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p + q)))\).
Substituting equals, we obtain \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1) = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1)\).
\end{proofstep}
The substitution uses the following argument.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\mathrm{False}\).
By definition, we obtain \(0 = 0\).
\end{proofstep}
The substitution uses the following argument.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\neg \mathrm{False}\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1)\).
\end{proofstep}
The substitution uses the following argument.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\mathrm{False}\).
By definition, we obtain \(0 = 0\).
\end{proofstep}
The substitution uses the following argument.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\neg \mathrm{False}\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1) = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1)\).
\end{proofstep}
By \paperlink{theorem:21}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:21}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right) < \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e64726f705f617070656e645f6f665f6c655f6c656e677468}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e64726f705f617070656e645f6f665f6c655f6c656e677468}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Step}\), we obtain \(\operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1)) = \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) + q)\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{theorem:4}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:4}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1) = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) + q\).
By the preceding argument, we obtain \(\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg \mathrm{False}\end{cases} = \begin{cases}0 &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg \mathrm{False}\end{cases} + q\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}}, \paperlink{premise:66616c73655f616e64}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:66616c73655f616e64}} and the two identities established above in the preceding result gives \(\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } \mathrm{False} \land q = 0\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg (\mathrm{False} \land q = 0)\end{cases} = \begin{cases}0 &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg \mathrm{False}\end{cases} + q\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}}, \paperlink{premise:65715f66616c7365}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f66616c7365}} (using \(p \ne 0\)) and the 4 identities established above in the preceding result gives \(\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } p = 0 \land q = 0\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg (p = 0 \land q = 0)\end{cases} = \begin{cases}0 &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg (p = 0)\end{cases} + q\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}}, \paperlink{premise:6164645f65715f7a65726f27}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6164645f65715f7a65726f27}}, \paperlink{premise:556e697175652e696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:556e697175652e696e737453756273696e676c65746f6e}} and the two identities established above in the preceding result gives \(\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } p + q = 0\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p + q,\allowbreak{} \begin{cases}\operatorname{first\,Return}(q) &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) &\text{otherwise}\end{cases} + 1) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg (p + q = 0)\end{cases} = \begin{cases}0 &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg (p = 0)\end{cases} + q\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}} and the two identities established above in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(p + q\right) = \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(p\right) + q\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:30}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{inside\,Part}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(p)) = p.\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
We first prove the following auxiliary lemmas.
\par\smallskip\noindent\paperlineanchor{aux:30:1}\textbf{Auxiliary lemma~30.1.} Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Let \(i\) be a natural number. Assume \(0 < i\). Assume \(\neg \left(i = i - 1 + 1\right)\). Then \(\mathrm{False}\).
\par\noindent\emph{Proof of the auxiliary lemma.} Use the hypothesis \(\neg \left(i = i - 1 + 1\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:4e61742e6c745f6f725f67745f6f665f6e65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e6c745f6f725f67745f6f665f6e65}}, we obtain \(i < i - 1 + 1 \lor i > i - 1 + 1\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(i < i - 1 + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}}, we obtain \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1 \lor i < 1 \land i - 1 = 0\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}} in reverse gives \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - 1 - (i - 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 - (i - 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Reversing the equality, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = i - 1 - (i - 1)\).
Use the hypothesis \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1\).
Taking the second conjunct, we obtain \(i - 1 = i - 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}}, we obtain \(i - 1 - \left(i - 1\right) = 0\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = 0\).

Taking the second conjunct, we obtain \(i - 1 = i - 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}}, we obtain \(i - 1 - \left(i - 1\right) = 0\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = 0\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464457175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464457175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).

Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}} with \(n = i - 1\) and \(m = 1\), we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 = i - 1 + 1\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}} in reverse gives \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).

Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).

Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - (i - 1 + 1 + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-(-2)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).

By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}}, we obtain \(\mathrm{False}\).

Consider the following case.

By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:31}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Then
\begin{center}

\end{center}

\begin{proof}
The substitution uses the following argument.

The substitution uses the following argument.

Consider the following case.

Use the hypothesis \(\neg (1 + \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) + 1 \le \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)) + 1 + 1)\).

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:32}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Assume \(p \ne 0\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{outside\,Part}(p) = p.\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
We first prove the following auxiliary lemmas.
\par\smallskip\noindent\paperlineanchor{aux:32:1}\textbf{Auxiliary lemma~32.1.} Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Let \(i\) be a natural number. Assume \(0 < i\). Assume \(\neg \left(i = i - 1 + 1\right)\). Then \(\mathrm{False}\).
\par\noindent\emph{Proof of the auxiliary lemma.} Use the hypothesis \(\neg \left(i = i - 1 + 1\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:4e61742e6c745f6f725f67745f6f665f6e65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e6c745f6f725f67745f6f665f6e65}}, we obtain \(i < i - 1 + 1 \lor i > i - 1 + 1\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(i < i - 1 + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}}, we obtain \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1 \lor i < 1 \land i - 1 = 0\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}

By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).

By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}}, we obtain \(\mathrm{False}\).

Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(i < 1 \land i - 1 = 0\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Use the hypothesis \(i < 1 \land i - 1 = 0\).
Taking the first conjunct, we obtain \(i < 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(i < 1\).

By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}}, we obtain \(0 \le 1 - \left(i + 1\right)\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(1 - (i + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(1 - (i + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Use the hypothesis \(0 < i\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(0 < i\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6164645f6f6e655f6c655f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6164645f6f6e655f6c655f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(0 + 1 \le i\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}}, we obtain \(0 \le i - \left(0 + 1\right)\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(0 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - (0 + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - (0 + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-(-1)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{combine}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{none},\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none})),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}}, we obtain \(\mathrm{False}\).
\end{proofstep}
The two alternatives exhaust the cases. Hence \(\mathrm{False}\).
\end{proofstep}
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(i > i - 1 + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f7375625f646963686f746f6d79}}, we obtain \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1 \lor i < 1 \land i - 1 = 0\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(1))) = \mathrm{true}) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(1))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}} in reverse gives \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - 1 - (i - 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 - (i - 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Reversing the equality, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = i - 1 - (i - 1)\).
Use the hypothesis \(1 \le i \land i - 1 = i - 1\).
Taking the second conjunct, we obtain \(i - 1 = i - 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f65715f7a65726f5f6f665f6571}}, we obtain \(i - 1 - \left(i - 1\right) = 0\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = 0\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464457175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464457175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Use the hypothesis \(i > i - 1 + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 < i\).

By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}}, we obtain \(0 \le i - \left(i - 1 + 1 + 1\right)\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).

Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}} in reverse gives \(i - 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).

Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).

Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
