Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - 1 + 1 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - (i - 1 + 1 + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - (i - 1 + 1 + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(2,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-(-2)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{combine}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(1)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none})),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}}, we obtain \(\mathrm{False}\).
\end{proofstep}
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(i < 1 \land i - 1 = 0\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Use the hypothesis \(i < 1 \land i - 1 = 0\).
Taking the first conjunct, we obtain \(i < 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(i < 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6164645f6f6e655f6c655f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6164645f6f6e655f6c655f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(i + 1 \le 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}}, we obtain \(0 \le 1 - \left(i + 1\right)\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(1 - (i + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(1 - (i + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
Use the hypothesis \(0 < i\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c745f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(0 < i\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6164645f6f6e655f6c655f6f665f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6164645f6f6e655f6c655f6f665f6c74}}, we obtain \(0 + 1 \le i\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}}, we obtain \(0 \le i - \left(0 + 1\right)\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(i = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By definition, we obtain \(0 + 1 = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(i - (0 + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(i - (0 + 1) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle\,\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-(-1)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{combine}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{none},\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none})),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle i\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{first\,Return}(p)\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle i - 1\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}}, we obtain \(\mathrm{False}\).
\end{proofstep}
The two alternatives exhaust the cases. Hence \(\mathrm{False}\).

The two alternatives exhaust the cases. Hence \(\mathrm{False}\).

\par\smallskip\noindent\paperlineanchor{aux:32:2}\textbf{Auxiliary lemma~32.2.} Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Let \(h\) be a proof of \(\neg \left(p = 0\right)\). \par\smallskip\noindent\emph{Proof of the main assertion.}\enspace
The substitution uses the following argument.
\begin{proofstep}

By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{denest}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}take}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1)) = \operatorname{denest}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}take}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1))\).

\end{proofstep}
Use the hypothesis \(p \ne 0\).
By \paperlink{premise:65715f66616c7365}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f66616c7365}}, we obtain \(\left(p = 0\right) = \mathrm{False}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6e6f745f66616c7365}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6e6f745f66616c7365}}, we obtain \(\neg \mathrm{False}\).
By \paperlink{premise:45712e6d70725f6e6f74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:45712e6d70725f6e6f74}}, we obtain \(\neg \left(p = 0\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e74616b655f617070656e645f64726f70}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e74616b655f617070656e645f64726f70}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Step}\) and \(i = \operatorname{first\,Return}\left(p\right) + 1\) and \(l = \operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right)\), we obtain \(\operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}take}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) + \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1)) = \operatorname{to\,List}(p)\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{theorem:4}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:4}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}take}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) + \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) = p\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{theorem:12}{Corollary~\ref{theorem:12}} and \paperlink{aux:32:2}{Auxiliary lemma~32.2} (using \(\neg \left(p = 0\right)\)) in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{denest}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}take}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1)) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg \mathrm{False}\end{cases}) + \begin{cases}0 &\text{if } \mathrm{False}\\ \operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}drop}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg \mathrm{False}\end{cases} = p\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:646974655f636f6e6772}}, \paperlink{premise:65715f66616c7365}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f66616c7365}} (using \(p \ne 0\)) and the 4 identities established above in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(\begin{cases}0 &\text{if } p = 0\\ \operatorname{denest}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}take}(p,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{first\,Return}(p) + 1)) &\text{given } h_{1}\text{ proving } \neg (p = 0)\end{cases}) + \operatorname{outside\,Part}(p) = p\).
By the preceding argument, we obtain \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{outside\,Part}(p) = p\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:33}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Assume \(p \ne 0\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1 = \operatorname{semilength}(p).\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + 1 + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + 1 + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:6164645f72696768745f636f6d6d}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6164645f72696768745f636f6d6d}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1 = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + 1 + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{theorem:16}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:16}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1 = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{theorem:15}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:15}} in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1 = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{theorem:32}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:32}} (using \(p \ne 0\)) in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1 = \operatorname{semilength}(p)\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:34}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Assume \(p \ne 0\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) < \operatorname{semilength}(p).\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
By \paperlink{theorem:33}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:33}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1 = \operatorname{semilength}(p)\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\neg (\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) < \operatorname{semilength}(p))\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f665f6465636964655f65715f74727565}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(0))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f6e6f6e6e6567}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f6e6f6e6e6567}} with \(n = \operatorname{semilength}\left(\operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(p\right)\right)\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{semilength}\left(\operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(p\right)\right)\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}} with \(n = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\) and \(m = 1\), we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1 = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}} with \(n = \operatorname{semilength}\left(\operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(p\right)\right)\) and \(m = \operatorname{semilength}\left(\operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(p\right)\right)\), we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 0\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 0\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e636f6d626f5f73617427}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e636f6d626f5f73617427}} with \(s = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none})\) and \(t = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{none},\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1))\) and \(1\) in place of its parameter \(a\) and \(x = \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle\) and \(b = -1\) and \(y = \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \left(\langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 0\rangle\right)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))\), we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}combo}(1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} -1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{none},\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1))),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Coeffs\mathord{:}combo}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} -1,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 0\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 0\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 0\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).

\end{proofstep}
The contrary assumption leads to a contradiction. Hence \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) < \operatorname{semilength}(p)\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:35}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Assume \(p \ne 0\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) < \operatorname{semilength}(p).\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
By \paperlink{theorem:33}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:33}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1 = \operatorname{semilength}(p)\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\neg (\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) < \operatorname{semilength}(p))\).
By definition, we obtain \(\operatorname{decide}(\operatorname{is\,Impossible}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1))) = \mathrm{true}) = \mathrm{true}\).

Use the hypothesis \(\neg (\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) < \operatorname{semilength}(p))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4e61742e6c655f6f665f6e6f745f6c74}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e6c655f6f665f6e6f745f6c74}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(p) \le \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c655f6f665f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6f664e61745f6c655f6f665f6c65}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(p) \le \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e7375625f6e6f6e6e65675f6f665f6c65}}, we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) - \operatorname{semilength}(p)\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f32}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(p) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e7375625f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) - \operatorname{semilength}(p) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(2),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e7375625f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle))\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) - \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) - \operatorname{semilength}(p) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}} with \(n = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\) and \(m = 1\), we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1 = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) + 1\).
By \paperlink{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:496e742e6f664e61745f616464}} with \(n = \operatorname{semilength}\left(\operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(p\right)\right)\) and \(m = \operatorname{semilength}\left(\operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(p\right)\right)\), we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f30}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e636f6f7264696e6174655f6576616c5f31}} in reverse gives \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e496e742e6164645f636f6e6772}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
Using \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e4c696e656172436f6d626f2e6164645f6576616c}} with \(l_{1} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(l_{2} = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))\) in reverse gives \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) + \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p)) + \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) = \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle) + \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).

Chaining the equalities, we obtain \(\operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle) - \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Linear\,Combo\mathord{:}mk}(0,\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = 0\).

By \paperlink{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f6f665f6c655f6f665f6571}} with \(\alpha = \mathbb{Z}\), we obtain \(0 \le \operatorname{eval}(\operatorname{coordinate}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle)))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e616464496e657175616c6974795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e636f6d626f5f73617427}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e636f6d626f5f73617427}} with \(s = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1))\) and \(t = \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none})\) and \(-1\) in place of its parameter \(a\) and \(x = \langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \left(\langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle -1\rangle\right)\) and \(b = 1\) and \(y = \langle 1\rangle\) and \(v = \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))\), we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}combo}(-1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(-1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1)),\allowbreak{} 1,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none})),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Coeffs\mathord{:}combo}(-1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} 1,\allowbreak{} \langle 1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e746964795f736174}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{tidy\,Constraint}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{tidy\,Coeffs}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(1),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle -1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle 1\rangle)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e636f6d62696e655f73617427}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{sat^{\prime}}(\operatorname{combine}(\operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{some}(0),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{none}),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{Lean\mathord{:}Omega\mathord{:}Constraint\mathord{:}mk}(\operatorname{none},\allowbreak{} \operatorname{some}(-1))),\allowbreak{} \langle 0\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle 1\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle -1\rangle),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{of\,List}(\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle \operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p))\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \langle \operatorname{semilength}(p)\rangle))) = \mathrm{true}\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c65616e2e4f6d6567612e436f6e73747261696e742e6e6f745f736174275f6f665f6973496d706f737369626c65}}, we obtain \(\mathrm{False}\).
\end{proofstep}
The contrary assumption leads to a contradiction. Hence \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p)) < \operatorname{semilength}(p)\).
\end{proof}

\section{Order}
\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:36}
Let \(p\) and \(q\) be elements of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Then \(q \le p + q\).
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
A descending chain would make the natural-number measure \(x \mapsto \operatorname{semilength}\left(x\right)\) strictly decrease at each step, so the relation is well-founded.
Proceed by well-founded induction to prove \(q \le p + q\). For an arbitrary element we may assume the claim for each strictly smaller element.
\begin{proofstep}
Fix \(p_{1}\) in \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\).
Assume \(\forall y\, :\, \operatorname{Dyck\,Word},\; \operatorname{semilength}(y) < \operatorname{semilength}(p_{1}) \implies q \le y + q\).
Distinguish whether \(p_{1} = 0\) holds.
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(p_{1} = 0\).
Rewriting with \(p_{1} = 0\), \paperlink{premise:7a65726f5f616464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:7a65726f5f616464}} and \paperlink{premise:6c655f7265666c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6c655f7265666c}} gives \(q \le p_{1} + q\).
\end{proofstep}
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(\neg \left(p_{1} = 0\right)\).
By \paperlink{theorem:35}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:35}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p_{1})) < \operatorname{semilength}(p_{1})\).
Use the previously proved fact \(\operatorname{semilength}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p_{1})) < \operatorname{semilength}(p_{1})\).
Applying the hypothesis \(\forall y\, :\, \operatorname{Dyck\,Word},\; \operatorname{semilength}(y) < \operatorname{semilength}(p_{1}) \implies q \le y + q\), we obtain \(q \le \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(p_{1}\right) + q\).
Using \paperlink{theorem:29}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:29}} in reverse under \(\neg \left(p_{1} = 0\right)\) gives \(\operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(p_{1}\right) + q = \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(p_{1} + q\right)\).
The second alternative suffices. Hence \(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(p_{1}) + q = \operatorname{inside\,Part}(p_{1} + q) \lor \operatorname{outside\,Part}(p_{1}) + q = \operatorname{outside\,Part}(p_{1} + q)\).
By \paperlink{premise:52656c6174696f6e2e5265666c5472616e7347656e2e73696e676c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:52656c6174696f6e2e5265666c5472616e7347656e2e73696e676c65}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\), we obtain \(\operatorname{Refl\,Trans\,Gen}(p_{2} \mapsto q_{1} \mapsto p_{2} = \operatorname{inside\,Part}(q_{1}) \lor p_{2} = \operatorname{outside\,Part}(q_{1}),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{outside\,Part}(p_{1}) + q,\allowbreak{} p_{1} + q)\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c452e6c652e7472616e73}{\emph{Alias}} (\paperlink{premise:4c452e6c652e7472616e73}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c452e6c652e7472616e73}}) with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\), we obtain \(q \le p_{1} + q\).
\end{proofstep}
The proposition or its negation holds. Hence \(q \le p_{1} + q\).
\end{proofstep}
The induction gives \(q \le p + q\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:37}
Let \(p\) be an element of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Then \(0 \le p\).
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
By \paperlink{theorem:36}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:36}} with \(q = 0\), we obtain \(0 \le p + 0\).
By \paperlink{premise:6164645f7a65726f}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6164645f7a65726f}} with \(M = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\) and \(a = p\), we obtain \(p + 0 = p\).
Substituting equals, we obtain \(0 \le p\).
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{theorem:38}
Let \(p\) and \(q\) be elements of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Assume \(p \le q\). Then
\begin{center}
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(q)).\)
\end{center}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
Use the hypothesis \(p \le q\).
Proceed by induction on \(h\).
\emph{Refl case.}
\begin{proofstep}
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e696e6669785f7265666c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e696e6669785f7265666c}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Step}\) and \(l = \operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right)\), we obtain \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))\).
\end{proofstep}
\emph{Tail case.}
\begin{proofstep}
Fix \(b\) in \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\).
Fix \(c\) in \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\).
Assume \(\operatorname{Refl\,Trans\,Gen}(p_{1} \mapsto q_{1} \mapsto p_{1} = \operatorname{inside\,Part}(q_{1}) \lor p_{1} = \operatorname{outside\,Part}(q_{1}),\allowbreak{} p,\allowbreak{} b)\).
Assume \(b = \operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(c\right) \lor b = \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(c\right)\).
Assume \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(b))\).
By \paperlink{premise:65715f6f725f6e65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:65715f6f725f6e65}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\) and \(c\) in place of its parameter \(x\) and \(y = 0\), we obtain \(c = 0 \lor c \ne 0\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(c = 0\).
For the required implication, argue as follows.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(b = \operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(0\right) \lor b = \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(0\right)\).
Use the hypothesis \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(b))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:6f725f73656c66}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:6f725f73656c66}}, \paperlink{theorem:27}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:27}}, \paperlink{theorem:26}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:26}}, \(b = \operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(0\right) \lor b = \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(0\right)\) and substitution of equals in the preceding result gives \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(0))\).
\end{proofstep}
Use the hypothesis \(c = 0\).
Reversing the equality, we obtain \(0 = c\).
Use the hypothesis \(b = \operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(c\right) \lor b = \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(c\right)\).
Substituting equals, we obtain \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
\end{proofstep}
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(c \ne 0\).
By \paperlink{theorem:4}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:4}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) + \operatorname{outside\,Part}(c) = c \iff \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) + \operatorname{outside\,Part}(c)) = \operatorname{to\,List}(c)\).
By \paperlink{theorem:32}{Lemma~\ref{theorem:32}}, we obtain \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word\mathord{:}nest}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) + \operatorname{outside\,Part}(c) = c\).
By the forward implication, we obtain \(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(c)) = \operatorname{to\,List}(c)\).
Use the hypothesis \(b = \operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(c\right) \lor b = \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(c\right)\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(b = \operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(c\right)\).
Choose the witness \(\langle U\rangle\).
Choose the witness \(\langle D\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(c))\).
Use the previously proved fact \(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(c)) = \operatorname{to\,List}(c)\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e617070656e645f6173736f63}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e617070656e645f6173736f63}} in the preceding result gives \(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} (\langle D\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(c))) = \operatorname{to\,List}(c)\).
This witness proves existence. Hence \(\exists t\, :\, \operatorname{List}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Step}),\; \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} t = \operatorname{to\,List}(c)\).
This witness proves existence. Hence \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
Use the hypothesis \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(b))\).
Use the previously proved fact \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
Use the hypothesis \(b = \operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(c\right)\).
Reversing the equality, we obtain \(\operatorname{inside\,Part}\left(c\right) = b\).
Substituting equals, we obtain \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(b),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e4973496e6669782e7472616e73}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e4973496e6669782e7472616e73}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Step}\), we obtain \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
\end{proofstep}
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Assume \(b = \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(c\right)\).
Choose the witness \(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle\).
Choose the witness \(\langle\,\rangle\).
Use the previously proved fact \(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(c)) = \operatorname{to\,List}(c)\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e617070656e645f6e696c}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e617070656e645f6e696c}} in the preceding result gives \(\langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle\,\rangle = \operatorname{to\,List}(c)\).
This witness proves existence. Hence \(\exists t\, :\, \operatorname{List}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Step}),\; \langle U\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{inside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} \langle D\rangle \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(c)) \mathbin{\Vert} t = \operatorname{to\,List}(c)\).
This witness proves existence. Hence \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(c)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
Use the hypothesis \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(b))\).
Use the previously proved fact \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(\operatorname{outside\,Part}(c)),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
Use the hypothesis \(b = \operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(c\right)\).
Reversing the equality, we obtain \(\operatorname{outside\,Part}\left(c\right) = b\).
Substituting equals, we obtain \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(b),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
By \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e4973496e6669782e7472616e73}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e4973496e6669782e7472616e73}} with \(\alpha = \operatorname{Dyck\,Step}\), we obtain \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
\end{proofstep}
The two alternatives exhaust the cases. Hence \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
\end{proofstep}
The two alternatives exhaust the cases. Hence \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(c))\).
\end{proofstep}
This proves \(\operatorname{Is\,Infix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(q))\).
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}\label{theorem:39}
Let \(p\) and \(q\) be elements of \(\operatorname{Dyck\,Word}\). Assume \(\operatorname{Is\,Suffix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(q))\). Then \(p \le q\).
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Use the hypothesis \(\operatorname{Is\,Suffix}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p),\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(q))\).
Consider the following case.
\begin{proofstep}
Fix \(r^{'}\) in \(\operatorname{List}(\operatorname{Dyck\,Step})\).
Assume \(r^{'} \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right) = \operatorname{to\,List}\left(q\right)\).
By \paperlink{premise:4479636b576f72642e636f756e745f555f65715f636f756e745f44}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4479636b576f72642e636f756e745f555f65715f636f756e745f44}} with \(\mathit{self} = q\), we obtain \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(q)) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(q))\).
Rewriting with \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f617070656e64}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e6c656e6774685f617070656e64}}, \paperlink{premise:49734c65667443616e63656c4164642e6164644c6566745265666c6563744c455f6f665f6164644c6566745265666c6563744c54}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:49734c65667443616e63656c4164642e6164644c6566745265666c6563744c455f6f665f6164644c6566745265666c6563744c54}}, \paperlink{premise:497343616e63656c4164642e746f49734c65667443616e63656c416464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:497343616e63656c4164642e746f49734c65667443616e63656c416464}}, \paperlink{premise:49734f72646572656443616e63656c4164644d6f6e6f69642e746f497343616e63656c416464}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:49734f72646572656443616e63656c4164644d6f6e6f69642e746f497343616e63656c416464}}, \paperlink{premise:4e61742e696e737449734f72646572656443616e63656c4164644d6f6e6f6964}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e696e737449734f72646572656443616e63656c4164644d6f6e6f6964}}, \paperlink{premise:636f6e74726176617269616e745f6c745f6f665f636f76617269616e745f6c65}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:636f6e74726176617269616e745f6c745f6f665f636f76617269616e745f6c65}}, \paperlink{premise:49734f7264657265644164644d6f6e6f69642e746f4164644c6566744d6f6e6f}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:49734f7264657265644164644d6f6e6f69642e746f4164644c6566744d6f6e6f}}, \paperlink{premise:4e61742e696e737449734f7264657265644164644d6f6e6f6964}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e696e737449734f7264657265644164644d6f6e6f6964}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e74616b655f6c65667427}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e74616b655f6c65667427}}, propositional extensionality, \paperlink{premise:4e61742e6164645f72696768745f63616e63656c5f696666}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4e61742e6164645f72696768745f63616e63656c5f696666}}, \paperlink{premise:4479636b576f72642e636f756e745f555f65715f636f756e745f44}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4479636b576f72642e636f756e745f555f65715f636f756e745f44}}, \paperlink{premise:4c6973742e636f756e745f617070656e64}{Prerequisite~P\ref{premise:4c6973742e636f756e745f617070656e64}}, \(r^{'} \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}\left(p\right) = \operatorname{to\,List}\left(q\right)\), \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(q)) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{to\,List}(q))\) and substitution of equals gives \(\operatorname{count}(U,\allowbreak{} \operatorname{List\mathord{:}take}(\operatorname{length}(r^{'} \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p)) - \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{to\,List}(p)),\allowbreak{} r^{'} \mathbin{\Vert} \operatorname{to\,List}(p))) = \operatorname{count}(D,\allowbreak{}
